# names (cap 16, limit at offset 20), count 2: "abcd" at 4 to 12, then a length word of 8 at 12 whose data would end at 24.

type names
breaks 5.2, point 7; 5.4, points 3.3 and 5
expect CapExceeded test.names
offset 12
extent none
requests test.names:slots2 test.label:4
input 00000002 00000004 61626364 00000008 61626364 65666768
